answer: Copied answers collide in public before they are graded. Each key docks its draft at a jetty at least 15 minutes before reveal by posting an onyx, a SHA-256 of the finished text; the reveal must hash to that value or it burns 20 POA and earns no score. The first key to post an onyx in the epoch is clean; every later key with the same hash is placed on one ledge and also burns 20 POA. A farm pasting one template across 500 keys leaves 499 copies on that ledge: 499 x 20 POA = 9,980 POA the attacker forfeits.
